ui.notifications.operation.progress.role: Live progress and final receipt for bulk notification read/dismiss or Undo
ui.notifications.operation.progress.tone: Concise factual status; avoid claiming all items changed.
ui.notifications.operation.progress.note: Three integer counts, each from actual server receipts. Changed is confirmed successful; skipped is explicitly refused/stale/already settled by the server; not confirmed includes not-yet-sent items and items whose network response was lost. Never translate not confirmed as failed, skipped, unchanged or unread: the operation may have reached the server. This line is displayed beside the existing action name and remains after partial failure.
ui.notifications.operation.progress.length: A wrapping status line, not a fixed-width button. Preserve all three counts and their different meanings.

placeholders.changed: Nonnegative count of items confirmed changed by server responses.
placeholders.skipped: Nonnegative count of items explicitly skipped in server responses.
placeholders.pending: Nonnegative count without a conclusive response, including items not yet attempted.
